description: This file defines the class AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewDetail, a view class for displaying PDF template details within the SuiteCRM application. It extends the base class ViewDetail and customizes the display by decoding HTML entities in certain bean properties.

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying PDF template details, extending the core ViewDetail class, with additional HTML decoding behavior for template fields.
